The '''Construction Foreman''' is a minor character in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
He is the foreman of the [[The Waste Ground|Waste Ground construction site]], just north of the [[Doherty Garage]] in [[Doherty (3D Universe)|Doherty]], [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
The foreman appears only in the mission [[Deconstruction]].

[[Kendl Johnson]] got angry because the construction workers disrespected her, prompting her brother [[Carl Johnson|Carl]] to go and teach them a lesson. While CJ is destroying the construction portables, the foreman hides in a portable toilet located on the construction site. Carl uses a [[Dozer]] to push the toilet into a ditch, with the foreman still inside. He then enters a [[Cement Truck]] and dumps cement into the ditch, burying the foreman alive.

==Character==
===Appearance===
He shares his model with some of the airport workers that can be seen walking and driving around in airport areas.

==Mission Appearance==
*[[Deconstruction]] <small>(Killed)</small>
